current_profile.tagline: 工作室予約・工具案内
current_profile.summary: 工作室の予約と工具カタログを提供するサービス。予約を独自Lexiconで表現し、利用者のPDSに保存する。
features: 独自Lexiconによる予約のPDS保存

description_sources.content: Workshop Atlas release announcement, 2026-09-22. Room booking ended on September 10. The former booking function represented reservations with a custom Lexicon and stored them in each user's AT Protocol PDS. Those schema definitions remain public. The tool catalogue continues; its entries come from our server database. Today we added CSV export of the catalogue, generated locally in the browser. This announcement does not discuss a successor booking service.
